rules.coverage_text: Most residential rentals, including mobile homes.

exemptions.description: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings (unless tenant requests application)
exemptions.quote: The exception is an owner-occupied two-, or three-family dwelling.

key_values.name: max_deposit
key_values.text: one and one-half times one month’s rent

rules.quote: The maximum-security deposit to be collected by the landlord cannot be more than one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 ). It can be less. Any additional yearly security deposit increase may not exceed 10% of the current security deposit.
rules.requirement: A landlord may not collect a security deposit above 1.5 times one month's rent. Yearly increases may not exceed 10% of the current deposit.
rules.title: Security deposit cap

rules.penalty: Tenant may sue for double the amount wrongfully withheld, plus costs and attorney's fees.
rules.quote: Within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy, a landlord must return the security deposit, plus interest earned less deductions, to the tenant ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.1).
rules.requirement: Landlord must return the deposit with interest less deductions within 30 days after tenancy ends.
rules.title: Security deposit return

rules.coverage_text: Most residential rentals including single-family homes and apartments.

exemptions.description: Owner-occupied premises with two or fewer rental units

rules.quote: A landlord must have good cause to evict a tenant (N.J.S.A. 2A:18-53).
rules.requirement: A landlord must have statutory good cause to evict a residential tenant or fail to renew a lease.
rules.title: Good cause eviction
